div.head: Northu 23
div.ab: Gif man preost gewundige, gebete man þa wyndlan ⁊ [biscope] to weofodbote for his hade sille XII ór; æt diacone VI ór to weofodbote.

If anyone wounds a priest, he is to pay compensation for the wounds and pay 12 ores to the bishop as compensation for [insult to] the altar on account of his orders; and for a deacon six ores as compensation for [insult to] the altar.

If anyone injures a priest, compensation is to be made for the injuries and, because of his order, twelves ores is to be given to the bishop as compensation to the church,; for a deacon, six ores as compensation to the church.
Wenn jemand einen Priester verwundet, büsse er die Wunde [ihm] und gebe [dem Bischofe] als Altarbusse für des [Verwundeten] Weihe 12 Ör; bei einem Diakon 6 Ör als Altarbusse.
If anyone wounds a priest, let him atone [to him] for the wound, and give [the bishop] 12 ores as altar-compensation for [the wounded man's] orders; for a deacon, 6 ores as altar-compensation.
div.note: D has a corrupt abbreviation here, which earlier editors read as ‘þæt’; Liebermann corrects it to ‘b[iscope]’ (compare 30). Liebermann compares II Cn 42.
